acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing an AEO service provider for your dental practice in New York City, look for agencies with proven experience in dental marketing and a deep understanding of local search dynamics. Inquire about their specific strategies for optimizing content for answer engines and their track record of securing featured snippets or voice search visibility. Ensure they can demonstrate how their approach aligns with current AI search trends and how they measure success. Ask for case studies or references from other dental clients, particularly those in competitive urban markets like NYC, to gauge their expertise and effectiveness.
acceptedAnswer.description: For an AEO provider in New York City, choose agencies with dental marketing experience, a strong understanding of local search, and proven strategies for securing featured snippets. Request case studies from clients in similar competitive markets.
